row.body: I saved the cloth with yellow dust for you. The field-sprayer test crew passed Friday before dawn; three people felt dizzy, and afterward the radio warned everyone indoors.
row.title: Friday before dawn — yellow dust

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same yellow dust while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
